chunks: Yunus, from Muhammad ibn Humran, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:

Abu Ja‘far عليه السلام said: “The minimum for which the hand of the thief is cut off is one-fifth of a dinar. One-fifth is the final limit below which cutting does not apply; cutting applies at that amount and at whatever is above it.”

key_terms.الْحَدِّ: the prescribed legal limit or punishment threshold
key_terms.الْقَطْعُ: amputation as the hadd ruling for theft
key_terms.تُقْطَعُ: is cut off, referring here to the legal hadd punishment
key_terms.خُمُسُ دِينَارٍ: one-fifth of a dinar, the stated legal threshold

ai.seo_question: What is the minimum amount of theft for which the thief’s hand is cut according to Imam Abu Ja‘far عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states the minimum threshold at which the hadd punishment for theft applies. It establishes that cutting is not carried out for anything less than one-fifth of a dinar, while it is carried out at that amount and above it.
